facts.value: The central study counseling supports you competently with all concerns regarding studying.
The Student Service Point and the hotline are your central points of contact for questions regarding study, application, and student administration.
The Student Secretariat is your reliable point of contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
In the examination offices, you will find contacts for all formal matters regarding your study performance, such as the thesis, exam registration, or certificates.

The PBS offers support and a listening ear for personal concerns. In addition to individual discussions, PBS offers online lectures and workshops on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management every semester.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blockages. In addition to individual and couple counseling, there are also group offerings.
In addition to a diverse sports program, the university sports also offer courses and videos on stress management and self-assertion as well as events to become active and make new contacts.

The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in entering the profession. Strengthen your career competencies through workshops, coaching, and networks. Free, practice-oriented, and individual - your springboard into the job.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and critically discriminatory environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Consultation in cases of discrimination as well as measures for prevention and reduction of discrimination.
Ombudspersons are your points of contact for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding your studies and promotion.
The scholarship service supports students and staff from all disciplines. Find your scholarship and benefit from individual advice!
The student services offer affordable housing near campus. Discover numerous dormitories, learn about rental prices, and apply online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans - the student services in Frankfurt inform about all possibilities of study financing and provide individual advice.
With our newsletter for students, parents, and teachers, we keep you regularly informed about the student offerings of Goethe University.
